annotations.title: Call an external tool via the executor

description: Forward a tool call to the organization's configured executor.sh MCP gateway (or any MCP-compatible gateway). Use this to let Tango reach tools hosted outside Tango, such as GitHub, Slack, or custom sandbox functions.

arguments.description: Arguments object to pass to the tool.

method.description: Protocol shape: 'tools/call' (MCP Streamable HTTP, default) or 'invoke' (simple {tool, arguments}).

tool_name.description: Name of the tool on the external gateway.

name: call_executor
title: Call an external tool via the executor
